description:
Update an existing Operator's registry entry.

Used when an Operator moves to a new MCP endpoint, changes its display
name, or needs to correct a registration. Called by an Authority when its
owner approves the operator's update request; the request must be signed
with that Authority's key.

authority_npub.description:
npub of the requesting Authority (must be a
registered authority or prime_authority).

display_name.description: New display name (leave empty to keep current).

operator_npub.description: Nostr npub of the Operator to update.

service_url.description: New MCP endpoint URL (leave empty to keep current).

name: update_operator
title: Update Operator
